name: @pipeworx/mcp-duffel

tools.name: duffel_flight_search
tools.description: Search flights (with pricing) from <origin> to <destination> on <date> — returns the 5 cheapest real, bookable offers from the Duffel Flights API, each with total price, airline, and per-segment flight numbers/times. Pass `return_date` for a round trip. This is REAL flight inventory: use a Duffel test token (duffel_test_...) for sandbox results. Example: duffel_flight_search({ origin: "JFK", destination: "LHR", departure_date: "2026-08-15", passengers: 2, cabin_class: "economy", _apiKey: "duffel_test_..." })

departure_date.description: Outbound date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. "2026-08-15"

return_date.description: Optional return date (YYYY-MM-DD). If given, searches a round trip (destination back to origin on this date).

cabin_class.description: Optional cabin: economy, premium_economy, business, or first

_apiKey.description: Your Duffel access token (from duffel.com). A test token "duffel_test_..." works against the sandbox.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-duffel forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the duffel pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
